scope: Every identity-eligible named person, organisation or controlled entity perimeter, institution and proceeding appearing across the two Magistrate-Judge López Villarrubia / Meeting Point hubs, machine matrix, human matrix, specialist audit and authority plan
scope_rule: This is an exhaustive 32-object census for the six named controlled surfaces. It does not alter or close the separate repository-wide 19/24 unitary caret census.
verdict: FULL CENSUS COMPLETE; 25/32 CARET_CONFIRMED; 7 CARET_PENDING; PARTIAL — NOT ALL IS^
invariants: A caret certifies identity resolution only.
A caret does not prove capacity on a date, participation, conduct, knowledge, intent, relationship, conflict, concealment, liability, source authenticity or outcome.
An existing CAEPR perimeter ID is not CARET_CONFIRMED when the text uses a broader or different unresolved legal-person perimeter.
The three exact 357/2024 debtors are not thereby identified as the Club Sei contracting entity.
Meeting Point Hotels is a confirmed commercial-perimeter label, not a resolved legal person for every act.
The Public Insolvency Register identity does not authenticate a notice or prove its signatory or allocation.
No ALL IS^ claim is permitted for this 32-object scope while any object remains CARET_PENDING.
